title: 第44章 美丽不是我一个人的妹妹

第44章 美丽不是我一个人的妹妹-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

“妈，我不是不想出钱。”

林国强站起来，看着李红霞，目光平静得让人发慌，“我是觉得这钱出了也是白出。

王超那个人，我比你们清楚，美丽嫁过去，一年之内必定出问题。

到时候家具拉不回来，钱也打了水漂。”

“你……你咒你妹妹？！”

林美丽从炕沿上站起来，脸涨得通红，眼泪在眼眶里打转，“二哥，你凭什么这么说？！你凭什么咒我？！

我嫁得好不好，跟你有什么关系？！”

“美丽，我没咒你。”

林国强转向她，语气软了一些，但还是很坚定，“我是为你好，你听我一句劝，再去打听打听王超这个人……”

“我不听！”林美丽捂住了耳朵，眼泪掉了下来，“你就是见不得我好！你就是看我要嫁到镇上去了，比你强了，你心里不平衡！

二哥，我以前觉得你对我好，现在我才知道，你就是个自私的人！”

自私。

这两个字像一把刀子，扎进了林国强的胸口。

但他没有躲，也没有解释。

他只是站在那里，看着林美丽。

十九岁的姑娘，穿着粉红色的新棉袄，头发扎着红头绳，脸上抹着脂粉。

她以为她要嫁到镇上去了，以为她以后就是镇上的人了，以为她从此过上了好日子。

她不知道，那个叫王超的男人，会在一年内把她的门牙打掉一颗，会在一年内把她的胳膊拧断三次。

会打得她流产落胎。

这些事，林国强都知道。

但他不能说。

说了也没人信。

“美丽，”他深吸了一口气，“你不听我的，我也没办法。

但我把话说清楚，家具，我不出。

你要是想打家具，让大哥、三弟和我三家平分掏钱。

一家出一份，公平合理，他们愿意出，我就愿意出，他们不出，我也不出。”

“你——！”林美丽气得跺脚，“你就是不想出！你找借口！”

“美丽，”林海柱的声音响起来，不大，但有一种不容置疑的威严，“坐下。”

林美丽咬着嘴唇，眼泪啪嗒啪嗒地掉，但还是坐下了。

林海柱看着林国强，沉默了很久。

他的目光在林国强脸上停留了好一会儿，像是在重新认识这个儿子。

“国强，”他终于开口了，声音沙哑，“你说家具三家平分出，这话当真？”

"Mom, it's not that I don't want to pay."

Lin Guoqiang stood up and looked at Li Hongxia, his eyes so calm that it made people panic, "I think this money is in vain.

I know Wang Chao better than you do. If you marry Meimei, there will definitely be problems within a year.

When the time comes, the furniture cannot be pulled back and the money has been wasted."

"You...you cursed your sister?!"

Lin Meili stood up from the edge of the kang, her face flushed, tears welling up in her eyes, "Second brother, why do you say that?! Why do you curse me?!

What does it have to do with you whether I marry well or not?!"

"Beautiful, I didn't curse you."

Lin Guoqiang turned to her and his tone was softer, but still firm, "I'm doing it for your own good. Please listen to my advice and go and find out about Wang Chao..."

"I won't listen!" Lin Meili covered her ears and shed tears, "You just don't like me! You just think that I'm going to marry in the town and I'm better than you. You feel unbalanced!"

Second brother, I used to think you were kind to me, but now I know that you are a selfish person!"

Selfish.

These two words were like a knife, piercing Lin Guoqiang's chest.

But he didn't hide or explain.

He just stood there and looked at Lin Meili.

The nineteen-year-old girl is wearing a new pink cotton-padded jacket, her hair is tied with a red tie, and her face is smeared with makeup.

She thought she was going to marry in the town, thought she would be a member of the town, and thought she would live a good life from then on.

She didn't know that the man named Wang Chao would knock out one of her front teeth and break her arm three times within a year.

It will cause her to have a miscarriage.

Lin Guoqiang knows all these things.

But he couldn't say.

No one believed it.

“Beautiful,” he took a deep breath, “If you don’t listen to me, there’s nothing I can do about it.

But I made it clear that I will not sell the furniture.

If you want to buy furniture, let the eldest brother, the third brother and I pay for it equally.

It is fair and reasonable for each family to contribute one share. If they are willing to contribute, I will be willing to contribute. If they do not contribute, I will not contribute either."

"You——!" Lin Meili stomped her feet angrily, "You just don't want to come out! You are making excuses!"

"Beautiful," Lin Haizhu's voice sounded, not loud, but with an unquestionable majesty, "sit down."

Lin Meili bit her lip, tears falling down, but she still sat down.

Lin Haizhu looked at Lin Guoqiang and was silent for a long time.

His eyes stayed on Lin Guoqiang's face for a long time, as if he was getting to know his son again.

"Guoqiang," he finally spoke, his voice hoarse, "You said that the three furniture families will be divided equally, are you serious?"
